properties.name: mpesa.daraja.consumer-key
properties.description: The unique Consumer Key generated from the Safaricom Daraja Developer portal.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.consumer-secret
properties.description: The unique Consumer Secret corresponding to your developer credentials.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.api-secret
properties.description: The Lipa Na M-Pesa Online passkey sent by Safaricom via email for production routing.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.environment
properties.description: The current operational mode. Toggles target endpoints between sandbox and production configurations.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.app-url
properties.description: The base root domain public address of the hosting application (e.g., https://api.yourcompany.co.ke).

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.cache-type
properties.description: The strategy used for storing tokens and transaction records. Options are 'local' or 'redis'.

properties.name: mpesa.daraja.confirmation-url-path
properties.description: The dynamic endpoint mapping path to catch payment confirmations.
